approval_conditions: Stage 1 is the fixed eight-cell joint-concave d20/d50 pilot.
Audit Stage 1 arrays, metrics, failures, and Slurm allocated time before Stage 2.
Every attempt, including failed or timed-out work, counts toward 120 GH200-hours.
Cumulative attempts for any cell may not exceed six GH200-hours.
Reserve a full six-hour allowance before dispatching each later cell.
No restart-from-scratch retry or budget extension; exact checkpoint resume is allowed only while cumulative cell usage remains below six GH200-hours.
Incomplete cells retain blank accuracy and are excluded from numerical curves.
